positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and owned a SOX-audited, revenue-critical backend platform for ad revenue recognition, billing, invoicing, and financial reporting, processing hundreds of millions of dollars annually and replacing spreadsheet-driven workflows
• Architected an immutable, versioned reconciliation engine enabling audit-safe reprocessing of historical campaigns while preserving closed accounting periods, eliminating hundreds of manual Excel reconciliations
• Reduced batch reporting latency from ~15 hours to ~7 minutes and improved API latency from ~50 seconds to ~200 milliseconds through object-level caching, pagination, read replicas, and targeted cache invalidation
• Built and operated ingestion pipelines and distributed APIs integrating Salesforce, NetSuite, DSP delivery data, and impression logs to support complex campaign models including discounts, multi-currency, and international markets
• Implemented a new revenue channel end-to-end, spanning schemas, pipelines, APIs, reporting, billing, and invoicing, contributing tens of millions of dollars in incremental revenue
• Created internal platform tooling (validation, caching, billing aggregation) that reduced new revenue source onboarding from ~2 weeks to ~1 day without deployments
• Led and stabilized a 7-engineer team after a manager departure, owning planning, estimation, mentoring, and promotion readiness
• Owned production reliability and financial close operations, implementing monitoring, on-call rotations, autoscaling, and blue/green deployments
positions.insights: Distributed Systems, Back-End Web Development and +12 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer 3 (Big Data)
positions.description:
• Re-architected a revenue attribution and sales pipeline, reducing end-to-end processing from days to under one hour, eliminating manual checks, and increasing company revenue by ~5%
• Designed and operated large-scale ETL pipelines using Spark, Hadoop, HBase, and Kinesis to ingest, transform, and persist structured and unstructured data from multiple external partners
• Built and maintained attribution pipelines integrating multiple third-party APIs, enriching datasets, leveraging ElasticSearch, and eliminating hours of manual matching work
• Developed data ingestion workflows for OEM incentive data, including vehicle style matching, stackability rules, delta computation via hashing, and historical persistence
• Owned pipeline reliability and operational health, implementing monitoring and automation to meet internal and external SLAs
• Collaborated closely with data scientists, product managers, and domain experts to deliver business-critical analytics services

projects.title: Fitzpo
projects.description:
• A fitness platform that aims to allow sharing workouts easily and make personal training accessible for all
• Handled UX and all authorization logic on the frontend with JWTs, React.js, and Redux to simplify state management
• Utilized Express to manage URL routes and define API calls
• Combined Multer with AWS S3's API to upload photos and store the link in each accounts respective Mongoose Schema
• Performed unit and integration testing for API calls with Mocha and Chai

projects.title: Vittles
projects.description:
• An Android app that chooses a place for you or your group to eat based on preferences and votes
• Employed Yelp’s Fusion API to perform queries on local restaurants
• Implemented groups and a voting system with Java and bridging it to the native Firebase
